title: Acorn Crossing
alt: A leaf-scaled animal and small horned goat beside a giant acorn on a pale pencil woodland path.
description: Two notebook animals cross a quiet path beside an oversized acorn.

title: Pondside Pause
alt: A long-beaked figure stands beside a small whale in a dotted pond, with reeds and a lobe-shaped cloud.
description: A quiet encounter at a small pond, assembled from five original notebook drawings.

title: Kitchen Garden Gate
alt: A hollow-log face, tall carrot, onion, oval stone and scalloped leaf at a lightly sketched garden gate.
description: A hollow-log gardener stands among oversized vegetables at a quiet garden gate.

title: Petal Weather
alt: A target-headed figure and large-eyed insect among drifting leaves and petals on ivory paper.
description: Five notebook drawings meet in a light breeze over an open common.

title: The Listening Grove
alt: A small dog sits on a stool beside a spiral-eyed flower, an evergreen and a yin-yang flower in a pale clearing.
description: A little seated dog listens among unusual flowers in a quiet pencil clearing.

title: Dry River Assembly
alt: A feathered parrot holding a staff and a long-eared seated animal meet by a dry riverbed with patterned objects.
description: Two notebook creatures meet among familiar leaf and patterned stone shapes.

title: Leaf Stage Rehearsal
alt: A jester-hatted monkey, waving lizard and pointed-ear dog rehearse beside a hanging pencil medallion and a leaf stage.
description: Three original notebook characters gather for an outdoor rehearsal beneath a geometric decoration.

title: Breakfast Errand
alt: A running beaked doodle passes a bicycle beside a bench with bread and tea.
description: A small breakfast errand assembled from a running creature, a wonky bicycle, bread, tea and a clover medallion.

title: Ridge Crossing
alt: A long-necked spiral snail crosses a small bridge above a patterned fish, with mountains beyond.
description: A slow crossing brings together the spiral snail, scaled fish, jagged mountain study and two unusual sky doodles.

title: Root Pantry
alt: A long-backed rabbit surveys a carrot, a sandwich and two floral vessels in a lightly drawn burrow pantry.
description: A shaggy rabbit and a striped carrot anchor a quiet pantry of floral vessels and a sandwich wedge.

title: First Orchard Steps
alt: An egg-bound long-necked hatchling meets a leaf-armored creature between two orchard trees.
description: An awkward first meeting in an orchard, with an apple between a hatchling and a leaf-armored figure.

title: Leaf Puppet Rehearsal
alt: Three peculiar face doodles rehearse on an open wooden stage beneath oak leaves and a diamond spark.
description: A sleepy stage mask watches two notebook figures rehearse beneath an oak-leaf curtain.

title: Creekside Chorus
alt: A long-tailed songbird and a striding fan-tailed bird meet below a floating heart-shaped bird beside a stream.
description: Three very different bird studies share a quiet creek, with a twisting tree and a small clover.

title: Odd Greetings Grove
alt: A curled eye-stalk creature greets a sail-backed animal beneath an eye and a tree with leaf-shaped roots.
description: Strange greetings among a curled creature, a sail-backed animal and an oak-leaf-nosed face in a lightly sketched grove.

title: The Orchard Has Opinions
alt: Pencil scene: A tiny daytime orchard council on an open hill; the bow-tied dancing tree, friendly bare tree and sleepy bird-tree appear to discuss where the path should go.
description: A tiny daytime orchard council on an open hill; the bow-tied dancing tree, friendly bare tree and sleepy bird-tree appear to discuss where the path should go.

title: A Very Slow Ferry
alt: Pencil scene: A quiet little river crossing, with a top-hatted snail waiting on the bank while an improbable two-serpent-legged rooster waits beside a three-sailed boat.
description: A quiet little river crossing, with a top-hatted snail waiting on the bank while an improbable two-serpent-legged rooster waits beside a three-sailed boat.

title: The Candlelit Rehearsal
alt: Pencil scene: An intimate rehearsal in a paper theater: a swept-hair bow-tied gentleman and a shaggy long-eared rabbit take their places beside a pair of candles.
description: An intimate rehearsal in a paper theater: a swept-hair bow-tied gentleman and a shaggy long-eared rabbit take their places beside a pair of candles.

title: The Sculpture Visitors
alt: Pencil scene: A tiny outdoor sculpture garden where the booted flower walker visits three eccentric living monuments.
description: A tiny outdoor sculpture garden where the booted flower walker visits three eccentric living monuments.

title: Visitors at the Root Room
alt: Pencil scene: A whimsical small cutaway under a tree: the underground eye-dweller receives a many-footed ghost and a leaf-crowned shirted visitor.
description: A whimsical small cutaway under a tree: the underground eye-dweller receives a many-footed ghost and a leaf-crowned shirted visitor.
